projects.title: Cardiac Tissue Modeling
projects.description: Development of heart MiMic systems with integrated electrical and mechanical sensors for studying cardiac physiology, drug cardiotoxicity, and disease mechanisms. Our platforms incorporate human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes in 3D microenvironments.

projects.title: Liver Toxicity Platforms
projects.description: Advanced liver MiMic models combining hepatocytes, endothelial cells, and Kupffer cells to predict drug-induced liver injury. Our systems enable long-term culture and metabolic profiling for pharmaceutical applications.

projects.title: Gut Microbiome Systems
projects.description: Microfluidic platforms that co-culture intestinal epithelium with complex microbial communities under physiological oxygen gradients. Applications include studying inflammatory bowel disease and host-microbe interactions.

projects.title: Lung Models for Infection Studies
projects.description: Air-liquid interface lung MiMic systems that replicate breathing mechanics and enable infection studies with respiratory pathogens. Relevant for COVID-19 research and inhalation toxicology.

projects.title: Vascularized Tissue Engineering
projects.description: Creating perfusable vascular networks in MiMic devices using 3D bioprinting and microfabrication. Essential for improving nutrient delivery and tissue viability in complex organ models.

projects.title: Biosensor Integration
projects.description: Development of electrochemical and optical biosensors for real-time monitoring of tissue function, metabolism, and barrier integrity in MiMic systems. Non-invasive and label-free detection methods.

projects.title: Tumor Microenvironment Models
projects.description: Cancer MiMic platforms that recapitulate the tumor microenvironment including immune cells, vasculature, and extracellular matrix. Used for studying metastasis and immunotherapy responses.

projects.title: Blood-Brain Barrier Platforms
projects.description: Microfluidic models of the blood-brain barrier for studying neurodegenerative diseases and evaluating drug permeability. Incorporates brain endothelial cells, pericytes, and astrocytes.

projects.title: Multi-Organ Platforms
projects.description: Body MiMic systems connecting multiple organ modules to study inter-organ communication, systemic drug effects, and pharmacokinetics. Enables more predictive preclinical testing.
